name: Presets
description: Built-in sketches that tour the Tartlet language: grooves, mini-notation, transforms, sound design and language features. Original compositions, written for Tartlet.
author: Tartlet

sketches.name: Groove
sketches.description: The design document example: drums, saw bass and a slow pad.
sketches.source:
setcpm(92/4)

$: s("bd*2 [~ bd] sd ~, hh*8").gain(.8)
$: note("<d2 d2 f2 c2>").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).release(.2)
$: n("<0 2 4 6>").scale("D:minor").s("triangle").room(.4).slow(2)

sketches.name: Four on the floor
sketches.description: Steady kick, off-beat hats and a pulsing bass.
sketches.source:
setcpm(124/4)

$: s("bd*4, [~ hh]*4, ~ cp ~ cp").gain(.9)
$: note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*2").s("sawtooth").lpf(500).release(.1)
$: n("0 ~ 4 ~ 7 ~ 4 ~").scale("C:minor").add(12).s("square").gain(.3).release(.05)

sketches.name: Ambient drift
sketches.description: Slow sine tones and soft chords in a wide room.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

$: n("<0 4 2 [6 5]>").scale("A:minor pentatonic").s("sine").room(.7).attack(.4).release(2).slow(2)
$: n("<[0,2,4] [3,5,7]>").scale("A:minor").s("triangle").gain(.35).attack(1).release(3).slow(4)
$: s("~ ~ ~ rim").gain(.4).room(.5)

sketches.name: Broken beat
sketches.description: Euclidean kicks, scattered hats and a filter that breathes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(170/4)

$: s("bd(3,8), ~ sd ~ sd, hh*16?0.3").gain(.9)
$: note("c2 [~ c2] eb2 [g1 bb1]").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(300, 1600).slow(4)).release(.15)

sketches.name: Chip arps
sketches.description: Square-wave arpeggios over a shifting chord root.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)

$: n("0 [2 4] 7 [4 2]").add("<0 5 3 4>").scale("C:major").s("square").gain(.3).release(.05)
$: n("<0 5 3 4>").scale("C:major").add(-14).s("triangle").release(.3)
$: s("bd [~ bd] sd ~, hh*8").every(4, x => x.fast(2))

sketches.name: Dub echoes
sketches.description: Off-beat chords with an octave echo layered on top.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

$: s("bd ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ sd ~, hh*4?").room(.3)
$: note("~ [c3,eb3,g3] ~ [c3,eb3,g3]").s("triangle").off(1/8, x => x.add(12).gain(.4)).delay(.5)
$: note("<c2 c2 ab1 bb1>").s("sine").release(.8)

sketches.name: Mirror
sketches.description: A melody on the left, its reflection on the right.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

$: n("0 2 4 <7 9>").scale("D:dorian").s("triangle").jux(rev).release(.2)
$: s("bd*2 sd, hh(5,8)").gain(.8)

sketches.name: Layers
sketches.description: Named parts with const, plus a seeded melodic surprise.

sketches.name: Mini-notation tour
sketches.description: Sequences, rests, groups, alternation and layered chords.

sketches.name: Stretch and repeat
sketches.description: Replicate with !, elongate with @, and speed steps up or down.

sketches.name: Euclidean rhythms
sketches.description: k hits spread over n steps, with rotation and patterned counts.
sketches.source:
setcpm(118/4)

$: s("bd(3,8), sd(2,8,4), hh(7,16)")
// every argument may be a pattern
$: s("rim(<3 5>,8,<0 2>)").gain(.6)
$: note("c2(5,8)").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).release(.1)
// the method form keeps a melody only on the hits
$: n("0 2 4 7").scale("E:minor pentatonic").s("triangle").euclid(5,8).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Polymeter
sketches.description: Layers of different lengths that share one step size.

sketches.name: Chance and choice
sketches.description: Seeded random drops and per-cycle choices. Change the seed for a new take.

sketches.name: Dot groups and variants
sketches.description: A lone dot splits the cycle into equal groups; name:index picks a variant.

sketches.name: Time shapers
sketches.description: One riff, reshaped with slow, rev, palindrome, late and early.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

const riff = n("0 2 4 5 7 5 4 2").scale("G:mixolydian")

$: riff.s("square").gain(.25).release(.05).every(4, rev)
$: riff.slow(2).add(-7).s("sawtooth").lpf(700).release(.2)
$: riff.palindrome().late(1/8).add(7).s("triangle").gain(.3).release(.1)
$: s("bd*2 [sd bd] ~ sd").fast("<1 2>")
$: s("~ cp").early(1/8).gain(.5)

sketches.name: Rotations
sketches.description: iter and iterBack start each cycle one step further along.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)

$: n("0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7").scale("D:dorian").s("triangle").iter(4).gain(.35).release(.08)
$: n("0 2 4 6").scale("D:dorian").add(-7).s("sawtooth").iterBack(4).lpf(900).release(.15)
$: s("bd sd [~ bd] sd, hh*8").every(3, iter(4))

sketches.name: Echoes and doubles
sketches.description: Shifted copies with off, stereo copies with jux, repeats with ply.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

$: note("c3 [eb3 g3] bb3 <g3 f3>").s("triangle").off(1/16, x => x.add(7).gain(.5)).release(.1)
$: s("bd ~ sd ~").ply("<1 2>")
$: s("hh*4").jux(x => x.fast(2).gain(.5))
$: note("<c2 bb1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(500).every(2, x => stack(x, x.late(1/2).add(12)))

sketches.name: Structure and masks
sketches.description: Borrow a rhythm with struct, cut holes with mask, thin out with degrade.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

$: note("<c3 eb3 f3 g3>").s("sawtooth").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~").lpf(900).release(.08)
$: s("hh*16").mask("<1 [1 0] 1 [0 1]>").gain(.5)
$: s("bd").struct("x(3,8)")
$: s("cp*8").degrade().sometimes(x => x.speed(2)).gain(.5)

sketches.name: Library tour
sketches.description: Layered copies, echoes, swing, seeded choices, moving chunks, counting and smooth noise.

sketches.name: Signals
sketches.description: Continuous shapes driving gain, pan, filters and pitch.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// signals glide between 0 and 1; range maps them onto any interval
$: s("hh*16").gain(saw.range(.2, .8)).pan(sine.slow(2))
$: note("c2*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(tri.range(300, 3000).slow(4)).resonance(6).release(.1)
$: n("0*8").add(square.range(0, 7)).scale("C:minor").s("square").gain(.25).release(.05)
$: s("rim*8").gain(rand.range(.2, .7)).pan(cosine)

sketches.name: Sound design
sketches.description: Envelopes, filters, distortion, echo and reverb on built-in synths.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)

$: note("<c3 g2>").s("sawtooth").lpf(isaw.range(600, 3000).slow(2)).lpq(8).attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.6).shape(.3)
$: freq("110 165 220 165").s("square").hpf(300).gain(.3).velocity(.8).release(.1)
$: s("bd sd:1 [~ bd] sd").crush(6).speed(1.5)
$: note("~ g4 ~ eb4").s("sine").vowel("<a o>").delay(.4).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.5).room(.6).size(.8).orbit(1)

sketches.name: Borrowed names
sketches.description: Names from other tools still play, with a note saying how they were read.

sketches.name: Binaural
sketches.description: Headphones on: a slow binaural drone, circling hats and placed bells.

sketches.name: Synth lab
sketches.description: Noise, envelopes, FM, unison, glide and named waveforms, all built from scratch.

sketches.name: Voices
sketches.description: A singing line with syllables, a small choir, a hum with an overtone, and a talking bass.

sketches.name: Field recording
sketches.description: Rain and a fire as beds, seeded foley, a circling bird, rooms, walls and grains.

sketches.name: Bindings and arithmetic
sketches.description: const values, exact constant arithmetic and constant spreads.
sketches.source:
setcps(.45)

const lag = 1/16
const bars = 2 * 2
const kick = s("bd [~ bd] ~ bd")
const snare = s("~ sd").late(lag)

$: stack(...[kick, snare])
$: s("hh*8").gain(.5).late(lag / 2)
$: n("0 2 4 6").scale("F:lydian").s("triangle").slow(bars).release(.3)

sketches.name: Named tracks
sketches.description: Named outputs, labels, and the cat, seq and silence combinators.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)

drums: s("bd*2, ~ sd, hh*4")
bass: note(cat("c2 c2", "eb2 eb2", "f2 g2")).s("sawtooth").lpf(600).release(.15)
lead: seq(note("g3"), note("bb3 c4"), note("~ d4")).s("square").gain(.25).release(.05)
$: s(cat("rim*2", silence, "cp")).gain(.5).label("fills")

sketches.name: Function arguments
sketches.description: A transform name, a partial application, an arrow and a block body.
sketches.source:
setcpm(108/4)

$: s("bd sd [~ bd] sd").every(4, rev)
$: s("hh*8").every(3, fast(2)).gain(.5)
$: note("c3 e3 g3 b3").s("triangle").every(2, x => x.add(5)).release(.1)
$: note("c2 ~ g1 ~").s("sawtooth").every(4, x => { return x.ply(2).lpf(400); }).release(.2)
